text: Learning a new skill can be an exciting journey, but it takes time and effort. First, you need to practise regularly, even if it is just for a short time each day. Patience is also important because you will not become an expert overnight. There are many resources you can use, such as online videos, books, or apps, to help you improve. It is a good idea to track your progress so you can see how far you have come. Finally, stay motivated by celebrating small achievements and reminding yourself why you started learning in the first place.
